description_en: Calls CreateKeyPair to create an SSH key pair. The system stores the public key and returns the unencrypted PEM-encoded PKCS#8 format private key. You must securely store the private key on your own
description_zh: 调用CreateKeyPair创建一对SSH密钥对。系统会为您保管密钥的公钥部分，并返回未加密的PEM编码的PKCS#8格式私钥。您需要自行妥善保管私钥部分
kebab_example: aliyun ecs create-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-key-pair-name testKeyPairName --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateKeyPair

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the key pair. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the latest region list.

parameters.description_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
parameters.description_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。

element_fields.description_en: The key of tag N of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
element_fields.description_zh: 密钥对的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
